caption:
A missed call doesn't have to mean a missed job.

Here's an example of what automated follow-up does in the background, minute by minute:

0:00 call rings out, no voicemail left
0:45 automated text goes out asking what they need
2:10 lead replies with the problem
4:30 two time slots sent back, job lands on the calendar

Nobody on the team touched a phone. Example workflow, not a live client account.

DM SCALE

#MissedCallTextBack #LeadFollowUp #ServiceBusiness #SpeedToLead #HomeServiceMarketing
rationale: Demonstrations is the under-served category this cycle, and a timestamped minute-by-minute walkthrough of missed-call text-back (distinct from the prior tutorial-script reel on the same feature) makes the abstract automation concrete.
